findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally authorizes users even when userTenant differs from documentTenant. Any caller relying on this exported guard can expose documents across tenant boundaries, whereas the prior implementation explicitly rejected mismatched tenants.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full base-to-head diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so mismatched tenants are now authorized; the reply's trusted-administrator claim is not reflected in the exported function's contract or implementation.
